headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson's impressive performance included three home runs and six RBIs. In other news, the Washington Nationals fell short in Philly, losing 3-6 to the Philadelphia Phillies, with Derek Hill leading the offense with a home run and four RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. The Chicago Cubs placed right-handed pitcher Clay Holmes on the 60-day injured list, while the Colorado Rockies placed left-handed pitcher Sean Sullivan on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 5, 2026. The Los Angeles Dodgers placed catcher Dalton Rushing on the 10-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

The Philadelphia Phillies traded right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson to the Athletics in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins made several trades, including acquiring right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling 4-3 Victory Over Brewers**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers in a close matchup, securing a 4-3 win. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 3 RBIs on 1 hit in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall to Cubs in 5-10 Thrashing**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Los Angeles Dodgers, winning 5-10 in a decisive game. Michael Busch led the Dodgers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have placed right-handed pitcher Clay Holmes on the 60-day injured list, marking a significant update to the team's roster.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. This move adds depth to the Athletics' pitching rotation.
